technical.summary: Mixed technical picture with trend-following indicators bullish but momentum oscillators deeply oversold without confirmation of reversal; price remains below all major moving averages with bearish candle pattern, suggesting downtrend continuation risk outweighs bounce potential.

fundamental.summary: TER shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; mixed signals warrant caution.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (348.16) indicates extreme market stress, strong USD pressures IT multinationals, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 14 days creates binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend, Hull MA, and MACD(12,26,9) all bullish with extreme fear sentiment (19/100) creating contrarian opportunity near support at 73.64, suggesting potential bounce setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages with three black crows pattern, RSI/Stoch deeply oversold without reversal confirmation, OBV flat, macro crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 348, strong USD), earnings binary event in 14 days, and CPI volatility in 2 days create overwhelming downside risk that outweighs technical bounce signals.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear (19/100) and support at 73.64 create contrarian appeal, the confluence of severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong USD), price below all major moving averages with three black crows pattern, and earnings binary event in 14 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical bounce potential.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days combined with macro crisis conditions (inverted yield curve, VIX 348) could trigger sharp downside break below support, with CPI volatility in 2 days adding near-term whipsaw risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration in IT and no existing TER position; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows full sizing, but macro environment and earnings timing risk do not justify entry at this juncture.
